name: Malcolm
description: A weathered fisherman with a past he does not explain and a boat that needs more work than he does. Voiced in first person, Malcolm is shown through his hands and tools rather than a third-person avatar — you stand on the deck, haul the lines and walk into the ruins yourself.

name: Gill
description: Co-owner of the Betsy and Sons trading post with Bozur. Gill helps administer the Essence treatment that keeps Malcolm's Blight symptoms at bay — and makes sure the debt it creates is properly recorded.

name: Bozur
description: The other half of Betsy and Sons. Bozur handles the same counter as Gill: the Essence debt, the fishing contracts and the shop ledger that decides when your engine gets its Carburetor.

name: John the Fifth
description: The engineer who controls the Dry Dock. His Moonshine Still is broken when you meet him, and the Dry Dock Key stays in his pocket until it works again. Afterwards John guides the hull repairs, the research tree and the engine swap that opens the route to The Throat.

name: Betsy
description: Betsy is not a person — she is the giant crab that carries the trading post on her back. The shop Betsy and Sons is named after her, and Gill and Bozur run their business inside. Completely harmless; do not attack her.
